title: Open compact-support extension preserves mixed upper weights
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $S_0$ put $S=S_0\times_{k_0}k$. Use the common-stage coefficient category $D^b_c(S,\Qlb)$ and its constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. Weil objects and equivariant morphisms are fixed pairs as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Mixed upper bounds and $D_{\le w}(S_0)$ have the meanings of [def-weil-punctual-weights; def-weil-complex-weights].

Let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, let $j$ be its base change to $k$, and use the compact-support functor $Rj_!$ of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] and its restriction to constructible hearts, $j_!F:=\mathcal H^0(Rj_!(F[0]))$ for the standard cohomology functor $\mathcal H^0$ [prop-constructible-truncations], with their induced Weil structures. For every $w\in\mathbf R$:
1. If a constructible Weil sheaf $F$ on $U_0$ is $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$, then $j_!F$ is $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$.
2. If $L\in D_{\le w}(U_0)$, then $Rj_!L\in D_{\le w}(X_0)$.
These assertions allow the zero sheaf and repeated terms in a mixed filtration.

proof.text: Choose a mixed filtration $0=F_0\subset\cdots\subset F_m=F$ with $Q_r=F_r/F_{r-1}$ punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $v_r\le w$, as in [def-weil-punctual-weights]. By [lem-zl-extension-by-zero-punctual], the very rational/common-stage compact-support functor in the statement sends heart objects to heart objects and induces the exact functor $j_!$ on constructible Weil sheaves. Apply it to every inclusion and quotient sequence. Part (a) of [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology] gives monomorphisms $j_!F_r\hookrightarrow j_!F$ and identifications $j_!F_r/j_!F_{r-1}\simeq j_!Q_r$ compatible with the quotient maps. Thus these objects form a finite filtration of $j_!F$, starting at zero and ending at $j_!F$. All maps commute with Weil structures because this is the exact functor on Weil sheaves asserted in the cited extension lemma.

source.place: Part 2: extension by zero of the target open restriction; old step 3.

proof.text: Each $j_!Q_r$ is punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $v_r$ by [lem-zl-extension-by-zero-punctual]. More explicitly, at a closed point in $U_0$ its coefficient fibre and local geometric Frobenius are those of $Q_r$; the residue field is unchanged by the open inclusion. Outside $U_0$ the fibre is zero and has no eigenvalues. Hence the filtration from Step 1 has pure quotients of weights $v_r\le w$ and proves assertion (1) by [def-weil-punctual-weights]. Purity is invariant under the displayed Weil-equivariant quotient isomorphisms: an intertwining isomorphism and its inverse carry nonzero eigenvectors to nonzero eigenvectors with the same eigenvalue. If $m=0$, exactness gives $j_!F=0$. Repeated terms remain permitted; their zero quotients satisfy every punctual purity condition vacuously.

proof.text: Let $L\in D_{\le w}(U_0)$. The bounded standard t-structure of [prop-constructible-truncations] gives integers $a\le b$ bounding its underlying object. Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-postnikov-extension-generation] with $n=b-a+1$. Write $L_0=0$, $L_n\simeq L$, with underlying distinguished triangles $L_t\to L_{t+1}\to\mathcal H^{a+t}(L)[-a-t]\to L_t[1]$. These can be taken to be the canonical truncation tower. Its objects and first two arrows lift to fixed pairs: for $g=g_U$, use the canonical comparisons $Lg^*\tau^{\le r}\simeq\tau^{\le r}Lg^*$ from [prop-constructible-truncations], followed by $\tau^{\le r}(\theta_L)$. The canonical truncation maps commute with these structures, since their comparisons are characterized by the truncation adjunctions and hence commute with the maps to $L$ [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles](1). The factor carries exactly the induced cohomology Weil structure specified in [def-weil-complex-weights]. Only the underlying triangles are asserted distinguished; [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] requires no triangulation of fixed pairs.

source.place: Propositions 1.3.3, 1.3.5 and 1.3.13, pp. 29-35; finite cohomology tower, applied to the standard constructible t-structure

proof.text: For $r=a+t$, put $A=\mathcal H^r(L)$. By [def-weil-complex-weights], $A$ is mixed of weights at most $w+r$. Apply assertion (1), already proved for every real bound, to obtain that $B=j_!A$ has this same bound. The heart-preservation assertion of [lem-zl-extension-by-zero-punctual] identifies $Rj_!(A[0])$ with $B[0]$. The shift comparison of [lem-zl-field-shriek-lower-bound] therefore gives $Rj_!(A[-r])\simeq B[-r]$. These comparisons carry the induced Weil structures: $Rj_!$ lifts to Weil complexes compatibly with the forgetful functor, its Weil isomorphism is built from the exchange map $\operatorname{Ex}_!$, and its comparison isomorphisms are morphisms of Weil complexes [prop-weil-operations]; $\operatorname{Ex}_!$ is a natural isomorphism of exact functors, so it commutes with the natural shift comparison. From $H^s(K)=H^0(K[s])$ in [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles](1), $B[-r]$ has cohomology $B$ in degree $r$ and zero otherwise, since $B$ is in the heart. Thus it belongs to $D_{\le w}(X_0)$: the only possibly nonzero cohomology sheaf has the required bound $w+r$, and zero sheaves have the empty mixed filtration. This proves the bound for every image factor of the tower.

proof.text: Apply $Rj_!$ to the underlying tower triangles, using its triangulated exactness from [lem-zl-field-shriek-lower-bound]. The image first two arrows are morphisms of fixed pairs because $Rj_!$ lifts to a functor on Weil complexes that commutes with the forgetful functor [prop-weil-operations]. Induct on $t$ with claim $Rj_!L_t\in D_{\le w}(X_0)$. For $t=0$, the exact functor sends zero to zero, whose cohomology sheaves have empty mixed filtrations [def-weil-punctual-weights; def-weil-complex-weights]. At the induction step, the first image term satisfies the claim by induction, and the third image term does by Step 4. Apply [lem-zl-complex-extension] to these first two equivariant arrows and their underlying distinguished triangle to obtain the claim for $Rj_!L_{t+1}$. At $t=n$ the Weil-equivariant endpoint identification gives $Rj_!L\in D_{\le w}(X_0)$, proving (2). The bounds also hold for $L=0$ and for an empty source; the same zero-object argument applies.

split_report.summary: No statement change and no new nodes. Extend the pure-quotient filtration using the existing exact common-stage open extension lemma, then apply exact compact support to the finite canonical cohomology tower and use extension closure of complex upper weights. Keep all triangles in the underlying common-stage coefficient categories and construct the induced fixed-pair structures by canonical truncation comparisons. No Lean written or compiled.
split_report.blueprint: lem-zl-morphism-open-closed-reduction, Part 2: the sentence that open extension by zero preserves the upper complex bound because stalks and pure-quotient filtrations extend by zero. The finite cohomology tower supplies the omitted passage from heart exactness to complexes.

tool_uses.why: Exactness and punctual purity of the same common-stage open compact-support functor; a coefficient-operation tool, not a replacement for open-closed reduction.
The generic exact-functor result carries subobjects and quotients of a finite filtration; the unit has no separate categorical transport lemma.
The bounded standard t-structure and its compatibility with Frobenius supply the canonical equivariant truncation tower.
The generic finite ordered cohomology tower supplies the induction for bounded complexes; no different geometric reduction is used.
Truncation adjunctions and the formula H^i(K)=H^0(K[i]) justify the fixed-pair truncation maps and the cohomology of shifted heart objects.
Only triangulated exactness and the natural shift comparison of the recorded common-stage compact-support functor are used; no lower-bound theorem about weights is used.

The Weil lift of the compact-support functor and the Weil-equivariance of its comparison isomorphisms (exchange map Ex_!) make the image tower arrows morphisms of fixed pairs; the unit has no node stating these lifts.
Extension closure for underlying distinguished triangles of fixed pairs is a generic weight tool for the finite induction.

Source: Part 2 of the main-20261015 proof of lem-zl-morphism-open-closed-reduction (j'_{0!} keeps stalks on V_0, is zero elsewhere, and extends filtrations by zero). Steps 1-2: lem-zl-extension-by-zero-punctual states that the same common-stage Rj_! preserves the heart, that the induced j_! is exact, the fibres and Frobenius compatibility, and preservation of purity. Part (a) of lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology carries the nested subobjects and quotients, so the filtration and its pure quotients transfer and clause (1) holds; the m=0 case and repeated terms are covered. Step 3: the Postnikov tower of lem-sfb-bounded-postnikov-extension-generation (n=b-a+1, L_t=tau^{<=a+t-1}L) is indexed correctly, and the truncations lift equivariantly through the automorphism comparisons in prop-constructible-truncations. Step 4 sign: H^r(L) has bound w+r, and B[-r] has its only cohomology in degree r, so the bound fits. Step 5: induction with lem-zl-complex-extension; it uses only the underlying triangles. Fault C4, repaired: in Steps 4-5 the Weil-equivariance of Rj_! and of its comparisons was credited to prop-functor-package, whose statement has no Weil lift. I replaced it with prop-weil-operations, which states the lift, its compatibility with For and Ex_!, and that the comparisons are morphisms of Weil complexes. I updated uses, proof_deps and tool_uses; there is no cycle, and the parent already cites this node. Neither belongs to the proof of the trace formula or of Poincare duality, and both are already in the parent's closure, so I accepted them.
